remarks:
Welcome to the future site of your new home! Set on 1.34 acres, this versatile parcel offers the rare option to build on either Draper or Hunts Corners—whichever best suits your vision. The property features beautiful mature trees that can be preserved to create instant privacy once construction is complete.
Conveniently located just 15 minutes from Transit Road by heading east on County Road, you’ll enjoy both seclusion and accessibility. Situated within the highly rated Akron School District, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for to bring your dream home to life.
